topic: Hélder's activities on Sunday and what he observed

statements.text: I had nothing against Renato personally. Professionally — look, he blocked my infrastructure budget three years running. But that's just... that's just how it goes.
statements.press_response: I mean — yes, it was frustrating. We're running on servers from 2014 because he kept saying 'insufficient ROI'. Do you know what that means for system uptime? But I didn't — this isn't relevant.

statements.text: I was doing a server migration on Sunday. Critical update. Couldn't wait.
statements.press_response: Remote. I was working remotely. The logs will show all the activity.

statements.text: I was home all Sunday. I didn't go into the office. There was no reason for me to be there.
statements.press_response: I really was working — the migration is documented. You can check the server logs.

statements.text: I didn't see anyone near Renato's area on Sunday. I wouldn't know anything about what happened on the main floor.
statements.press_response: I mean... I might have been in the corridor at some point. For coffee. I don't remember specifically.
